what: AMETEK makes electronic instruments and electromechanical devices: precision measurement tools, analytical instruments, motors, and specialty materials used in aerospace, medical, power and industrial equipment.
customers: Aerospace and defence manufacturers, medical device makers, power and process industries, and research laboratories.
money: precision motion control, engineered materials and connectors
moat: Hundreds of niche products where it is the leading supplier in a market too small to attract large competitors, sold into equipment that is costly to requalify.
risks: Growth depends on continuous acquisitions rather than the existing businesses
Debt of about $7 billion funds that acquisition programme
Industrial demand in Europe and China has been soft
A high valuation relative to its organic growth rate
opportunities: Operating margin of 26% is unusually high for an industrial manufacturer
Aerospace and medical demand has been strong
A long record of buying niche businesses and raising their margins
watch: Organic order growth and the pace of acquisitions.
